caseStudy.context: SPA AADL Gest-Immo manually evaluated bids for waterproofing tenders: Excel processed file by file, repetitive administrative, technical and financial phases — error-prone and slow.
caseStudy.role: Freelance Python developer: complete design and development of the desktop application, from data automation to report generation.
constraints: 3 evaluation phases to automate: administrative, technical, financial
Heterogeneous Excel data to normalize (Pandas / OpenPyXL)
App usable by non-technical staff → simple desktop UI (PyQt5)
approach: Mapped the existing evaluation process with the client
Python processing engine: Excel ingestion, advanced filtering, per-phase scoring
Clean PyQt5 interface: file import, processing status, exports
Automated exports in 2 formats: Excel and PDF, ready for validation
caseStudy.outcome: 50+ files processed with over 70% evaluation time saved. All 3 phases (administrative, technical, financial) are now fully automated, with Excel and Word exports.
